# Synthetic fastboot-info fixture (AOSP v1 grammar)
version 1
flash bootloader bootloader.img
flash radio radio.img
reboot bootloader
flash boot boot.img
flash init_boot init_boot.img
flash vendor_boot vendor_boot.img
reboot fastboot
update-super
flash system system.img
flash vendor vendor.img
flash product product.img
flash vbmeta vbmeta.img --apply-vbmeta
if-wipe flash userdata
if-wipe erase metadata
flash dtbo dtbo.img --slot-other
reboot fastboot
